target_customer: Government, defense, homeland security and corporate security teams with camera, body cam and drone footage
problem: Security teams cannot search large volumes of video without predefined rules; Conntour lets them query it in natural language, on premises.
business_model: Enterprise and government software, deployed on premises, pricing not stated
product_category: Video intelligence and natural language video search

founders.name: Tomer Kulla
education: BSc Computer Science, computer vision focus
previous_startups: Nilus (founded and sold), eCommerce ad-tech and recommendation engine
founders.background_notes: The founders say they met about 13 years ago in mandatory military service in special forces.

competitors.name: Verkada
competitors.what: Natural language video search over cameras using CLIP embeddings
competitors.funding_then: Valued at 3.2B after a 2024 round per search result

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time vision language search over many camera feeds, deployed fully on premises on modest GPUs, is hard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Security vetting, on premises deployment and government relationships are hard to copy, though the core search technique is known.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Verkada shipped natural language search in May 2024 and others followed in 2026, but no acquisition of Conntour found.

market_need_then: Existing video analytics required predefined rules; defense and homeland security buyers had massive unsearched footage, and a paying Singapore government customer was claimed on the YC page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline 'A New Era of Video Intelligence'; YC launch titled 'Ask security cameras anything'

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found beyond funding press; name is close to Contour.

outcome_analysis: Conntour is active with a team of 20 and emerged from stealth in March 2026 with a 7M seed led by General Catalyst. Founders come from Israeli military surveillance, matching their defense and government buyers, and one has a prior exit. The main risk is camera vendors such as Verkada bundling similar search.
notes: conntour.com fetch returned only a page title, so website content was not available. One database lists 7.4M total with an earlier March 2025 round, unconfirmed. Headquarters conflicts (Tel Aviv versus Miami). The 50 camera feeds per GPU claim is from one aggregator. A reported Palantir Fellowship and ex-CIA advisor come from the YC page only.
